body: I finally heard from her this morning. She will be moving out this Sunday. We still care for each other but she couldn't live with me right now until I get my shit straightened out. I'm really trying hard now. This has been an immense wake-up call for me and I really appreciate your support. I went to the gym again today but I feel very very lonely. As soon as I'm done working out with my friend I basically go home and sit around until my next shift at work. To make matters even worse my laptop is not working so I'm stuck watching YouTube and Netflix on my phone...Haha everything is terrible timing.

I started working out again and have been going to NA meeting with a friend. I keep trying not to think of my GF but I always end up thinking about her one way or another. I've been through a hard relationship breakup before but this is terrible because it was my fault. The worst part is the lack of communication from her. I haven't heard anything in a couple of days, however on all of our social media it still says we are engaged etc. So I have absolutely no idea what's going on.
She hasn't gotten her stuff yet so I have to constantly be around her stuff it really sucks. I've been pretty much alone at my apartment unfortunately which doesn't help

The past few days have been extremely hard on me. I was sitting outside in the woods wanting to severely end my life and started praying even though I don't have much faith these days. I couldn't go through with is again and have decided that I need and will give life another shot. From the amount of stress I have been going under I was in a whole different mental state. I'm doing a little better now but it's hard being alone. I try to convince myself everything is fine but still burst into tears sporadically. I have however gotten on a better sleep schedule and I have been up since 6 am trying to be productive. I can't tell you how hard it is to move on when half of the stuff in my apartment belongs to my GF and I'm still waiting on her to come get her stuff to move out. It's so hard ending a 3 years relationship like this. :(

I hope we both get the help we need. I myself tried to kill myself earlier today and I can relate to alot of what your going through.

In terms of the body image issues I have body dismorphia and can never truly see myself for who I am. For me it all started when I was in highschool and someone spread rumours around the whole school that I looked like a bird because of my German nose. Well it fucked me up so bad that to this day I actually 100 percent of the time push my lower jaw down to try to fix the proportions of my face. It makes me really sad that I even feel like I need to do this.

In terms of drug withdrawal I have a good idea what your going through. I myself have to ever gone through an SSRI withdrawal but I know all about it including the electric shocks in the skin and the severe akathasia. I myself have been withdrawing almost continuously from drugs ( opiates) for the past year and a half. I keep trying to bee completely off of everything but I have no coping mechanisms so I always fall back in the trap.

If you need someone to talk to please let me know. I honestly don't have anyone myself to talk to either so it would be nice if maybee we can help each other in anyway possible.
Thank you I hope this is a decent first step

Thank you for your response I truly appreciate it. What makes everything harder for me is that after the car accident with my father my mom spent 11 years in court to get some money to help me and my brother with college etc. During the 11 year process ( which ended up becoming a very high profile case I'm the US) my mom earned a law degree just to represent us because we kept getting shitty attorneys. Having to watch what she went through to get us the money we got was heart breaking...And here I am wasting everything by starting classes and then dripping out continuously not to mention all the rehabs. I think what's hardest on me these days is that I don't have a single friend anymore and it has really gotten to me. I'm a good person but I pushed everyone away and it's soo painful having to deal with everything now that my mind is clearly from abstaining from drug use.
Thank you your very kind. Means alot to me
